item.title: Scarlett Johansson says her 'The Batman: Part II' role spurred "lot of existential angst"
item.description: Hollywood actor Scarlett Johansson has opened up about her role in the upcoming DC film 'The Batman: Part II'. In a recent interview, Johansson shared that her upcoming role in the Robert ...
item.content:encoded:
Scarlett Johansson says her 'The Batman: Part II' role spurred "lot of existential angst" Johansson shared that her upcoming role in the Robert Pattinson-led film, stating that it has pushed her outside her comfort zone. ANI | Updated: 05-11-2026 23:33 IST | Created: 05-11-2026 23:33 IST

Actor Scarlett Johansson (File photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Hollywood actor Scarlett Johansson has opened up about her role in the upcoming DC film 'The Batman: Part II'. In a recent interview, Johansson shared that her upcoming role in the Robert Pattinson-led film, stating that it has pushed her outside her comfort zone and spurred a "lot of existential angst, for some reason," as per Variety. "It was very hard to figure out. I don’t know why, whether it was just the role or it was just where I am in my life, but it was just hard to crack it. And that’s all I can say about it," she said, as quoted by Variety. However, the 'Avengers' star refrained from sharing many details about her character. In May, Johansson's role was confirmed in an X post by director Matt Reeves, with a GIF of the actress' reflection in a car's rear-view mirror from the 2013 film 'Under the Skin'. Meanwhile, production on the film is currently being led by director Steven Soderbergh after Reeves, who also helmed 2022's 'Batman'. "Once you get past the origin tale, which we didn’t quite do, but we did something that referred to his origins, then you start telling the Rogues Gallery story and that character’s sort of arc. But I never wanted to lose Robert Pattinson at the centre of these stories, and so that is really what we set our aim on," Reeves said in a previous interview. Besides Pattinson and Johansson, the film features Sebastian Stan, Charles Dance, Brian Tyree Henry, Colin Farrell as the Penguin, Andy Serkis as Alfred Pennyworth, and Jeffrey Wright as Commissioner Gordon. (ANI)

item.title: QUOTES-Soccer-Reaction to Cristiano Ronaldo's Portugal retirement

item.content:encoded:
QUOTES-Soccer-Reaction to Cristiano Ronaldo's Portugal retirement Reuters | Updated: 05-11-2026 23:33 IST | Created: 05-11-2026 23:33 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Following are reactions after Portugal great Cristiano Ronaldo, the all-time leading scorer in men's international soccer, announced his retirement from the national team on Thursday. PORTUGUESE FOOTBALL FEDERATION "Every drop of sweat, every decisive goal, and every captain's arm-band he wore with honour on the field reflected his unconditional love for our jersey. His dedication and his legacy transcend the four lines of the field. "Ronaldo has raised Portugal's profile and inspired generations of young people who dream of following in his footsteps; for many of us, he is the greatest player of all time!..." AL-NASSR, RONALDO'S CURRENT CLUB "It's not just a chapter — it's history you've shaped. You're an icon to the entire world, not just Portugal. Portugal is in your heart, and you are in the hearts of the world. A page has turned, but there is still history left for us to write together at your home, Al-Nassr." MANCHESTER UNITED, RONALDO'S FORMER CLUB "Congratulations on an incredible international career." JORGE JESUS, PORTUGAL COACH "This is all his decision. We already had the opportunity to talk about this before the first call-up. I asked him to stay, to stay with me because I needed him to be by my side, but I have to accept his decision," Jesus told Canal 11. "He is a world reference, a reference for Portugal, a reference for the national team. He is a player who, throughout these years, has given a lot to the national team. He is a symbol for Portuguese youth. Most of his fans are young. "I had the opportunity to share the experience of working with him for a year at Al-Nassr. Therefore, he will always be a reference for our national team, for our people, for our history." BRUNO FERNANDES, PORTUGAL AND MANCHESTER UNITED MIDFIELDER "Thank you for the inspiration. It was a privilege to be able to share great moments with our national team alongside my childhood idol." DIOGO DALOT, PORTUGAL AND MANCHESTER UNITED FULLBACK "They don't know that dreams are a constant in life..." "Portugal's history tells us that we are a people who have never accepted limits, unafraid of uncharted seas or weathering storms. We were and are shaped by achievements, sacrifices, tears, and sweat... By dreams that seem impossible — until someone has the courage to make them a reality. You did it. You made us believe, dream, and achieve! "A legacy that will be remembered not only for the trophies or the goals, but also for the path you paved for all those who came after you. Your passion and determination to represent our country is something I'll never forget and that will stay with me forever. "I'm immensely proud of everything you've done for our national team! Thank you, idol." PEPE, FORMER PORTUGAL AND REAL MADRID CENTRE BACK "It was more than just soccer. Thanks for everything, Cris." GIANNI INFANTINO, FIFA PRESIDENT "Few players have ever touched the heart of football fans around the world quite like Cristiano. A career defined by extraordinary talent, relentless determination and an unwavering desire to push the boundaries of what is possible... "Cristiano has achieved milestones that may never be matched but his greatest legacy goes far beyond records, trophies and goals... "Thank you, Cristiano, for the passion, the unforgettable moments and the immense contribution you have made to our beautiful game proudly wearing the "Selecao" shirt. "Your international career will forever be part of football's history." (Compiled by Pearl Josephine Nazare in Bengaluru; Editing by Toby Davis)

item.description: Actor-model Pamela Anderson will be honoured with a lifetime achievement award at Italy's Torino Film Festival, where she will be present to introduce a special screening of Gia Coppola's 'The Last ...
item.content:encoded:
Pamela Anderson to be honoured with Lifetime Achievement Award at Torino Film Festival At the Torino fest, Pamela Anderson will hold an onstage conversation ahead of 'The Last Showgirl'.  ANI | Updated: 05-11-2026 22:29 IST | Created: 05-11-2026 22:29 IST

Pamela Anderson (File photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Actor-model Pamela Anderson will be honoured with a lifetime achievement award at Italy's Torino Film Festival, where she will be present to introduce a special screening of Gia Coppola's 'The Last Showgirl'. At the Torino fest, which is a pre-eminent event for young directors and indie cinema run by Italy's National Film Museum, Pamela Anderson will hold an onstage conversation ahead of 'The Last Showgirl'. The film significantly earned her a 2025 Golden Globe nomination for her performance, also marking a comeback for the former 'Baywatch' star. "Movies can sometimes work wonders, like making us really meet for the first time someone we’ve known all our lives. With ‘The Last Showgirl,’ Pamela Anderson gave us this experience. We thought we knew everything about her, but in this film every gesture of hers revealed a sensitivity as a performer that is both moving and surprising," said Torino Film Festival artistic director Giulio Base, as quoted by Variety. She will be honoured with Torino's Stella della Mole Award, previous recipients of which include Spike Lee, Antonio Banderas, Angelina Jolie and Sharon Stone. After 'The Last Showgirl', Anderson went on to feature alongside Liam Neeson in Paramount's reboot of 'The Naked Gun' and Karim Ainouz's family satire 'Rosebush Pruning'. She was subsequently at the Venice Film Festival in September with Kornel Mundruczo's road film 'Place To Be'. She co-starred with Ellen Burstyn, Taika Waititi, and Murray Bartlett. On the current work front, Pamela Anderson recently wrapped shooting a slate of upcoming films, including Brian Klugman's 'Somedays' with Billy Bob Thornton, Michael Cera's 'Love Is Not the Answer', and Sally Potter's 'Alma'. Meanwhile, Torino's 44th edition is set to take place between November 24 and December 2 in the Northern Italian city of Turin. (ANI)
